purpose: Advisories (npm and NuGet) that the dependency gate tools/audit/audit-gate.mjs tolerates for now. An entry is a dated decision, not a permanent exception. Rules and routine: docs/06-engineering-process.md section 4.

entryFormat.advisory: GHSA id exactly as the report prints it, e.g. GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx
entryFormat.package: the vulnerable package, not the package that depends on it
entryFormat.severity: what the report says, for the reader (the gate matches on advisory and package)
entryFormat.reason: why it is acceptable and what would end it: at least 30 characters, say why it cannot reach a shopper or staff user, and what fix you are waiting for
entryFormat.acceptedBy: the person who accepted it (GitHub username)
entryFormat.acceptedOn: YYYY-MM-DD, the UTC date (the gate compares with the UTC day; in Sri Lanka that is yesterday between 00:00 and 05:30)
entryFormat.reviewBy: YYYY-MM-DD, after acceptedOn and no more than 90 days after it; the gate fails the day after this date
entryFormat.issue: optional: the GitHub issue that tracks removing it

notes: Only HIGH and CRITICAL advisories need an entry; the gate ignores the rest.

A NuGet advisory also fails restore in the build jobs (warnings are errors). Accepting one needs a NuGetAuditSuppress item as well, which is a coordinated change to Directory.Build.props or Directory.Packages.props; the suppression alone does not satisfy this gate.
The gate fails on an entry whose advisory is no longer reported. Delete it, do not leave it to pre-approve the next advisory.

Overrides in src/frontend/package.json (#226, 2026-10-21): "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk": "1.32.1" clears GHSA-22jm-h49p-29qw and GHSA-46jr-4wx8-v453, because @angular/cli 21.2.27 (newest 21.x) pins 1.31.0 and the SDK only serves the optional `ng mcp` command. Remove the override once an @angular/cli 21.x release depends on @modelcontextprotocol/sdk >=1.32.0 (check with `npm view @angular/cli@21 dependencies`).

vite is NOT overridden (#226): @angular/build 21.2.27 pins vite to exactly 7.3.6, and 7.3.7 also changes dev-server behaviour (safeModulePaths, transformIndexHtml), so forcing it would run Angular on a vite it was not released with. The vite entry below is accepted instead; delete it once an @angular/build 21.x release ships vite >=7.3.7, after bumping all @angular/* tooling packages in step.

entries.reason: Transitive dep of @angular/build (Angular CLI tooling). Used only in the dev server and test runner, never bundled into the deployed browser app. Forward fix requires downgrading from Angular 21 to 20 (breaking change). Waiting for @angular/build 21.x to ship undici >=7.31.0.

Extraneous package — present as a dev-tooling leftover in node_modules, not reachable from package.json. DoS is in HTTP server request parsing, irrelevant to a browser bundle. Will be removed by running npm ci after lockfile cleanup; fix is available via npm audit fix.

Dev server only; launch-editor; not shipped. vite is used by @angular/build for `ng serve` and by Vitest for `ng test` (developer machines and CI), and never runs in the storefront, admin or API that shoppers and staff use. Waiting for an @angular/build 21.x release that ships vite >=7.3.7 (21.2.27 pins 7.3.6); Angular 22 is a major upgrade, planned separately.
